## 席位核对 · PR #27038 ← #26679 · epic PM `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` · 2026-10-28T02:43Z

Verdict: **REWORK (patch round on this PR, same claim)** — not governed (0 of 28 paths), +1602 / −94. The drawer side is judged complete on the branch; the card's list-root half is held only by the plugin-list fence, which lifts when #27031 (#26681) merges — it is queued now. One PR lands the whole card rather than a `Part of` plus a follow-up.

What the seat read and accepts as built (head `ec88340391`):
- `navigation-overlay.tsx`: three optional props `onBack` / `trail` / `stepper`; the title goes `sr-only` on every host (ruling 2); `Escape` pops when `onBack` is set; `ArrowUp` / `k`, `ArrowDown` / `j` on the document while the drawer is open, never inside a text field, a composite widget or with modifiers (ruling 3's ↑ ↓, no counter).
- `app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` + `recordDrawerContext.ts`: an in-memory stack over a host-controlled root, ← plus a clickable path, per-level `?tab=` kept and restored, ↑ ↓ through the level's sibling set (the related list's rows on show, threaded `RelatedList.onRowClick` → `onView` third argument), ⤢ at any level opens the record page with the levels below as its existing `?from=` trail, and the page's 「收为抽屉」 link restores the stack once from history state.
- `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.openRecord`: related rows and lookups share one handler; with a drawer host and a drawer-mode target it pushes in place, a `page` / `new_window` / `none` object still navigates (ruling 5, never a second drawer); `RecordDetailView` is a host too (`RecordPageDrawerHost`).
- Tests: app-shell 1801 files / 16511 passed; components + plugin-detail + i18n + react 977 files with the one arity pin re-pinned at a per-site arity of 3; new suites `navigation-overlay-bar-26679` (9), `recordDrawerStack-26679` (12), `RelatedList.rowClickSiblings-26679` (2). Gates 34 / 34 run, the `vitest run scripts/` red is the known macOS host gap. CI in progress at the time of writing.
- Premise corrections accepted: the top bar draws no crumb on object routes, so the path rides `?from=` and the page back link (the card's crumb line was aspirational); the dispatch wrongly said the ⤢ tooltip was done.

Patch round (one stroke, after #27031 is on `main`):
1. Merge `origin/main` (brings `ListView`'s `recordOpen` / `recordLinkAdornment` host props from #27031); add `onRowsChange` to `ListView` (sibling of `onTotalChange`, the rows on show in their shown order), and have `ObjectView` pass `root.siblings` + `onRootStep` to `useRecordDrawerStack` so the list root draws ↑ ↓ like the page host does — then change the body's first line to `Fixes #26679`.
2. zh copy: the drawer's expand control and the list's ↗ are one action — set `console.objectView.expandToPage` (zh) to 「整页打开」 so it matches `console.objectView.openAsPage` from #27031; en stays.
3. Screenshots (card acceptance 2): HotCRM lead → task at the drawer root, one level down, and the page opened by ⤢ from the task level, on a never-merged evidence branch, linked in the body — or state that the seat's own preview run stands in, and the seat will run it on the final head.
4. Keep the ui doc drift note (`user-state-persistence.md` listing retired modes) in Acceptance notes; not this card.

## 席位核对 · PR #27038 ← #26679 · epic PM `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` · 2026-10-28T06:33Z

Verdict: **ACCEPT** — ordinary queue landing (governed register: 0 of 37 paths; +2015 / −107, under the 3000-line threshold). Supersedes the REWORK above: both patch rounds landed on this PR under the same claim.

Checklist, judged on GitHub and on the branch:
- Shape: draft → `main`; first line now `Fixes #26679` (set by the seat in this stroke with the body edits the dev's two reports listed; the dev did not touch the body); one closing keyword; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in the body and in `.changeset/26679-drawer-in-place-navigation.md` (patch for components, app-shell, plugin-detail, plugin-list, react, i18n). No `content/docs/releases/`, no `packages/spec`.
- Scope: 37 files. The plugin-list producer (`ListView.onRowsChange`) waited for #27031 to land (merged 04:31Z) and was added in patch round 2 on top of the merged main, so the two PRs never raced on `ListView.tsx`; the rest is the claim's surface plus two named consequences: `data-table.tsx`'s row-click heuristic (the HotCRM run found related rows inside the drawer opened nothing; the fix only stops clicks from a dialog that does not contain the row) and the two served approval-page pins re-pinned to the drawer-host behaviour (their target objects declare no `navigation.mode`, ruling 5).
- Spot checks (seat readings on `811a10fa14`): `ListView.tsx` reports rows keyed on the ids in order through a ref'd callback, only where `onTotalChange` answers, holding the last answer while a load is in flight; `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` keeps the ids as a joined key, builds `drawerRoot.siblings` from them and steps the root by rewriting `?recordId=` with `replace`; `data-table.tsx`'s `portalledFrom(target, row, selector)` returns true only when the matched dialog does not contain the row.
- Rulings on the screenshots (evidence `8ef7f64917`, three PNGs read by the seat): root bar `⤢` `✕` only (rulings 2 / 3); one level down `←` · path 「线索 Mira Costa - Atlas Construction › 任务」 · `↑` `↓` · `⤢` · `✕` (ruling 5); the page after `⤢` draws the back link and 「收为抽屉」. Root `↑` `↓` came after the screenshots; the seat's own console run on the final head stands in.
- Tests and gates: as the body's Tests / Gates sections state (34 / 34 run; the `vitest run scripts/` red is the known macOS host gap, CI owns it); three reverse verifications with mutation counts and a clean `git diff HEAD`. Pinned to head `811a10fa14`: 43 success, 10 skipped, 0 other. Verify lock UNLOCKED (disclosed).
- Acceptance notes (four): agreed, none filed; the ui doc drift note (`user-state-persistence.md` still naming retired modes) is carried to the epic's docs card #27059.
- Deviations recorded: report comments posted through `with-fleet.sh` (the relay refuses this desktop session id); two evidence-branch pushes; two merge conflicts resolved toward #27031 as landed.

Landing: ready + auto-merge in this stroke on the maintainer's standing authorization for this epic (verbatim, 2026-10-28: 「授权你用车队身份给 #26758 翻 ready 并挂 auto-merge（squash），后续本 epic 的 PR 复核 ACCEPT 后同样处理」); the queue decides the rest.
